request: Build a kanban task board app in a single HTML file. Three columns (To Do, In Progress, Done) hold task cards. Tasks can be added per column, deleted, and moved between columns with HTML5 drag-and-drop. All state persists to localStorage and the board re-renders on every change.

intent.goal: kanban task board app in a single HTML file.

planFiles.summary: Kanban board HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
